companyDescription: Precision oncology / rare disease · bezuclastinib (selective KIT inhibitor) with three PDUFA dates: GIST combo Nov 30, 2026 (Priority Review), NonAdvanced Systemic Mastocytosis Dec 30, 2026, AdvSM Jun 29, 2027 · $791M cash, runway into late 2028 · commercial team in place
priceNote: Self-fetched (Yahoo chart API, Nov 18, 2026 intraday): $28.66 (+2.9%). Not in the live-prices cache. Down from $31.64 at the Nov 11 screen and near the 1-year closing low ($27.44, Nov 16), well below the 1-year high ($42.84). The pullback is sector-wide small/mid-cap biotech weakness into the S&P's 5-month low, not company news.
summary: Two dated FDA decisions inside six weeks: bezuclastinib's GIST combination PDUFA is Nov 30 (Priority Review, 12 days out) and NonAdvanced Systemic Mastocytosis is Dec 30, with AdvSM on Jun 29, 2027. Cash is $791M (Sep 30), funding into late 2028, and the commercial team is hired. The stock has pulled back to $28.66, near its 1-year low, against a ~$54 May–Aug consensus (+88%; even a $45 best-effort target clears the 20% gate). fda_decision is a core tier-2 leader (+8.1pp medianExcess vs +4.1pp overall, n=11) — a mild tailwind only. Core at-catalyst median is -6.5% (n=157, 65% underwater), so Entry 2 is preferred. Base +25% spans both PDUFAs (~6 weeks), above the 14d P75 (+10.8%) by design.

catalysts.name: PDUFA — bezuclastinib + sunitinib in GIST (Priority Review)
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for the GIST NDA under Priority Review (company Q3 2026 update). Second-line GIST is the larger near-term commercial indication; approval would make Cogent a commercial company before year-end.

catalysts.name: PDUFA — bezuclastinib in NonAdvanced Systemic Mastocytosis
catalysts.description: FDA target action date Dec 30, 2026 for NonAdvSM, backed by the SUMMIT Phase 2 data. This is the second approval shot inside the window.

catalysts.name: AdvSM PDUFA + SUMMIT switch sub-study data
catalysts.description: AdvSM has a Jun 29, 2027 PDUFA. The company plans a first look at patients switching from avapritinib (Ayvakit) to bezuclastinib — the competitive-positioning data point.

risks: Binary FDA risk on both dates: a CRL or label restriction (safety, dosing) would hit hard. Small/mid-cap CRLs have produced -38% to -75% one-day moves (CAPR Jul 2025, ALDX Mar 2026).
Competition: avapritinib (Ayvakit) is entrenched in systemic mastocytosis, and the switch data are not out yet. Launch uptake against an incumbent is the post-approval question.
Spending ramps before revenue: Q3 net loss was $111.4M (vs $80.9M) with G&A up to $42.1M, plus $108.5M of non-cancelable manufacturing commitments.
Approval may be largely priced as 'expected' — 'sell the news' is common for Priority Review drugs with clean data.
Macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26; mid-cap biotech has been selling with the tape.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp.

macroRisk.sectorImpact: A funded (into 2028) mid-cap biotech: rates matter through XBI risk appetite, not financing. The FDA outcomes dominate.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — idiosyncratic FDA catalysts, but macro is WAIT (30/100) and biotech is trading with the tape. Prefer the dip entry near the 1-year low.

entryStrategy.verdict: BUY (Speculative sizing) — two dated PDUFAs in six weeks with funding into 2028. The measured core at-catalyst median is -6.5% with 65% of picks underwater at their event, so report price is not the default entry: Entry 2 ($26.80–27.80) is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Priority-review biotechs often drift up 1–2 weeks before a PDUFA. COGT has done the opposite (-9% since Nov 11) with the biotech tape, so positioning into Nov 30 is light.

postWin.note: SRPT gained ~74% on eteplirsen's accelerated approval (Sep 2016); AXSM rose ~40% on Auvelity's approval after an extended review (Aug 2022); VERA rose only ~7% on its approval day (Jul 2026). Clean, expected approvals sit at the low end.

postLose.note: CAPR fell ~38% on its deramiocel CRL (Jul 2025); ALDX fell ~75% on its third reproxalap CRL (Mar 2026).

spotSizing.reason: 6% (spot). fda_decision is a core tier-2 leader (+8.1pp medianExcess vs +4.1pp overall, n=11) — a mild tailwind only. Two shots on goal and funding into 2028 support mid sizing; macro WAIT and the binary gap risk keep it below 10%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the fda_decision medianMAE (-10.6%). A break below ~$24.90 before Nov 30 means the market is pricing a CRL.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If GIST gets a CRL, exit — the Dec 30 SM decision alone does not justify holding through a -40% gap.
